context: M15 o4. Varelas vaults, emergency lantern. Yiannis with a thermometer. Silence where the hum should be.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: Compressors stopped twenty minutes ago. Forty-one degrees. Climbing.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: Mink, six hours. Fox, less. Customers' coats, Niko. Not ours.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Ice. Every block in the city. The ice house on Tenth.

lines.speaker: char.yiannis_doukas
lines.text: Ice house wants cash. In a brownout everybody wants cash.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Everybody gets paid. That's not corruption. That's payroll. Come on.
